question: Should artifact support mean pre-rendering every old artifact output, or live-rendering source documents with runtime renderer support for the active artifact families present in the imported EPP corpus?
recommended_answer: Live-render from source, with runtime renderer support for active EPP artifact families. Pre-render only for export, print, review snapshots, or disposable caches.
answer: Live-render from source, with runtime renderer support for active EPP artifact families. Pre-render only for export, print, review snapshots, or disposable caches.
rationale: This keeps the app source-driven and avoids inheriting the old static build style while still making active EPP artifact content browsable.
